sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: Good evening, everybody.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 各位晚上好。

sentences.en: Today we are pleased to have invited Maggie Shorts from Harvard University to tell us her feeling of studying together with her mom.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 今天我们很高兴邀请到哈佛大学的玛吉·肖茨，请她谈谈与妈妈一起上大学的感受。

sentences.en: Well, Maggie.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 那么，玛吉。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I’m very happy to meet you all.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到大家。

sentences.en: Maggie, are you and your mom studying the same major at the university?
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 玛吉，你和妈妈在大学里学的是同一个专业吗？

sentences.en: Not really.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 并不是。

sentences.en: She is studying in law school and I’m studying journalism.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 她在法学院读书，而我学的是新闻学。

sentences.en: So, you see she is a graduate student while I am an undergraduate.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 所以，她是研究生，而我是本科生。

sentences.en: Since we started at the same time and hers is a four-year night program, our school schedules are synched.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 我们是同时开始上学的，而她读的是四年制夜校课程，所以我们的学习日程同步。

sentences.en: Which means?
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 也就是说呢？

sentences.en: We follow the same schedule of study.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 我们的学习日程安排是一样的。

sentences.en: We take our exams during the same busy weeks and experience similar relief at the end of December and May.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 我们都在同样忙碌的几个星期里考试，也都在十二月和五月结束时如释重负。

sentences.en: Last spring, we compared notes on our cover letters and interviews for our job applications.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 去年春天，我们还交流了求职信和求职面试方面的心得。

sentences.en: Last June, as we were both preparing for our summer internships, my mother and I traded fashion advice.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 去年六月，我们都在准备暑期实习，妈妈和我还交换过穿搭建议。

sentences.en: Presently, we will probably graduate within days of each other.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 目前看来，我们毕业的日期可能只相差几天。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 真有意思。

sentences.en: Then you must have a lot in common at study.
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 那么，你们在学习上一定有不少共同点。

sentences.en: You bet.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 那当然。

sentences.en: As students, we’ve shared study habits (take notes by hand), general truths (You can’t avoid having a few bad professors), and encouraging platitudes (like, it’s okay! No one will care how you did on your “Science of Cooking” or “Constitutional Law” midterm!).
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 作为学生，我们有共同的学习习惯，比如手写笔记；有共同的体会，比如难免会碰到几个不太好的教授；也会说些鼓励人的套话，比如“没关系，没人会在意你《烹饪科学》或《宪法学》期中考得怎么样！”

sentences.en: Where she’s listened to my complaints about freshman-year roommates and dining-hall food, I’ve helped her buy textbooks online and wished her luck in moot-court practice.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 她听我抱怨大一时的室友和食堂饭菜，我则帮她在网上买教材，还祝她模拟法庭练习顺利。

sentences.en: Occasionally, we’ve even studied together.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 有时我们甚至会一起学习。

sentences.en: When Mom came to visit during Freshman Parents Weekend, I took her into the library on the pretext that she was on a library tour.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 妈妈在大一新生家长周末来探望时，我以她在参观图书馆为由，带她进了图书馆。

sentences.en: We sat side by side in the big open room on the first floor—she diligently taking notes on a huge red volume that she had lugged from New York City on the train, I casually reading about Greek myths.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 我们并排坐在一楼的大阅览室里：她认真记着笔记，读的是她从纽约坐火车费力带来的一本厚厚的红皮书；我则随意翻看希腊神话。

sentences.en: What do you think is the biggest advantage of having a parent studying together with you?
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 你觉得和父母一起上大学最大的好处是什么？

sentences.en: I know that my mother has felt the frustration of a paper that won’t write and the excitement of mastering a difficult topic.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 我知道，妈妈也经历过论文写不出来的挫败感，以及攻克一个难题后的兴奋。

sentences.en: I don’t need to explain my elaborate theory that I am a “bad test-taker”—she said the same thing about herself.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 我不必费心解释自己“不会考试”的那套复杂理论，因为她也这样说过自己。

sentences.en: And talking with her is a good way to get perspective on those occasional hurdles that crop up in college.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 和她聊聊天，能让我更理性地看待大学里偶尔出现的那些障碍。

sentences.en: Although we are both taking a substantial course load, Mom is also working a full-time job in the financial industry.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 虽然我们两个人的课业都很繁重，但妈妈同时还在金融行业做着一份全职工作。

sentences.en: That urges me to study harder, so I should say encouragement.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 这激励我更加努力地学习，所以我会说，最大的好处是受到鼓舞。

sentences.en: Any disadvantages then?
sentences.speaker: M
sentences.zh: 那么，有什么不利之处吗？

sentences.en: Well, sometimes I wonder whether we are getting a little too involved in each other’s scholastic lives.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 有时候，我会想，我们是不是过多地介入了彼此的学业生活。

sentences.en: This usually occurs to me about twice a year, when my mother calls to inform me of her grades.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 通常每年大约有两次，妈妈打电话告诉我她的成绩时，我就会这样想。

sentences.en: Once, she reached me in the middle of a date (“I got my first A! Aren’t you going to congratulate me?”), and often, when the news has been disappointing, I haven’t known how to respond.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 有一次，她在我约会到一半时联系我，说“我第一次拿到A了！你不祝贺我一下吗？”而当她的成绩不理想时，我常常不知道该如何回应。

sentences.en: Last fall, I was chastised for passing along a speculative tidbit I had heard in the dining hall—that, because of grade inflation, GPAs once considered good might be viewed with new scrutiny.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 去年秋天，我把在食堂听到的一条未经证实的消息转告给她，结果受了责备：由于成绩膨胀，以前被认为不错的平均绩点，现在可能会受到更严格的审视。

sentences.en: “Jane has informed me that ’B is the new F,’” Mom announced at Thanksgiving.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 感恩节时，妈妈宣布：“简告诉我，现在的B就等于以前的F了。”

sentences.en: I didn’t know what to say to comfort her.
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 我不知道该说些什么来安慰她。

sentences.en: This is the end of part one of the interview.
sentences.zh: 访谈的第一部分到此结束。
sentences.asr_text: This is the end of part one of the interview.
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: Questions one to five are based on what you have just heard.
sentences.zh: 第1至5题根据你刚才听到的内容提问。
sentences.asr_text: Questions one to five are based on what you have just heard.
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: Question 1. What is the topic of the interview?
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 第1题：这次访谈的主题是什么？

sentences.en: Question 2. Which of the following indicates that they have the same study schedule?
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 第2题：下列哪一项表明她们的学习日程相同？

sentences.en: Question 3. What do the mother and the daughter have in common as students?
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 第3题：作为学生，母女二人有哪些共同之处？

sentences.en: Question 4. What is the biggest advantage of studying with Mom?
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 第4题：和妈妈一起上大学最大的好处是什么？

sentences.en: Question 5. What is the biggest disadvantage of studying with Mom?
sentences.speaker: W
sentences.zh: 第5题：和妈妈一起上大学最大的不利之处是什么？

zh: 作为学生，我们有共同的学习习惯，比如手写笔记；有共同的体会，比如难免会碰到几个不太好的教授；
也会说些鼓励人的套话，比如“没关系，没人会在意你《烹饪科学》或《宪法学》期中考得怎么样！”
她听我抱怨大一时的室友和食堂饭菜，
我则帮她在网上买教材，还祝她模拟法庭练习顺利。
我们并排坐在一楼的大阅览室里：
她认真记着笔记，读的是她从纽约坐火车费力带来的一本厚厚的红皮书；我则随意翻看希腊神话。
有一次，她在我约会到一半时联系我，说“我第一次拿到A了！你不祝贺我一下吗？”
而当她的成绩不理想时，我常常不知道该如何回应。
去年秋天，我把在食堂听到的一条未经证实的消息转告给她，结果受了责备：
由于成绩膨胀，以前被认为不错的平均绩点，现在可能会受到更严格的审视。
